run_eval_episode: run the image navigation agent evaluation loop in the Habitat simulation environment
run_get_config: run get_config to load and parse a YAML config file for the Habitat environment
run_habitat_imagenav_env: run HabitatImageNavEnv to create a Habitat-based image navigation environment with a given config
run_imagenav_agent: run ImageNavAgent to instantiate an image navigation agent using the provided config
run_record_video: run record_video to compile saved images into a video in the target directory
